title: Record green coffee lot number with each roast
body: Highland Imports (Tom Becker) is shipping the new Ethiopia Yirgacheffe and Colombia Huila lots on Oct 28. Add an optional `--lot` argument so each roast log records which lot it came from. That way we can trace any flavor change back to the shipment.

title: Export a side-by-side chart of profiles A, B and C
body:
For the Holiday Blend tests we compared profiles A, B and C by eye from the CSVs. It would help to have a `compare.py` that plots bean temperature over time for several logs on one chart.

Dana Whitfield wants to show the chart at the next weekly ops meeting to explain why profile B (light-medium, 11:30 total) won.
